text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] runtime-queue-depth (us-west-2) > 95th percentile threshold for 3m. P50 latency climbing, error spike: 503s. paging oncall group.

alex-r: saw the page, grabbing. on my way.

maria-p: i'm oncall and joining — looking at the runtime dashboard.

sam-g: quick read: spike seems correlated with bursty long seq requests from tenant: dev-sandboxes + one enterprise stream. KV cache miss rate up, inflight count hitting 80% cap.

maria-p: can we do a fast mitigation: 1) apply tenant soft cap 2) reduce request timeout 3) disable prefix_caching_experimental?

sam-g: yes. propose: set max_inflight=6 for public-dev tenants, throttle QPS to 5 for sandbox role, request_timeout -> 20s. disable feature flag: prefix-cache-experimental=off.

ops-runner: running playbook now:
```
# set tenant cap
/redwoodctl tenant update --tenant-role=sandbox --max-inflight=6 --qps=5
# adjust global timeout
/redwoodctl config set runtime.request_timeout_seconds 20
# toggle feature
/redwoodctl feature toggle prefix_cache_experimental off
```

ops-runner: applied tenant caps + timeout change. feature toggle request registered, feature turned off on routing nodes.

maria-p: seeing immediate drop in inflight for sandboxes to ~40%. queue latency median down ~28% within 90s. errors still elevated but trending down.

alex-r: good. which customers are showing 503s? need list for CS.

sam-g: primarily: sandbox orgs (ids: sb-43, sb-98), and enterprise tenant: acme-retail — they had partial 503 cascade on streaming endpoints. acme appears to be hitting model fallback path; we've routed them to smaller model fallback.

jamie-c: i'm pinging customers. short update: "We've applied emergency throttles and timeout tuning to reduce impact; monitoring shows improvement. Incident ID INC-2026-71685. Will follow up when stable." sending now.

maria-p: routing fallback for acme was applied?

ops-runner: yes -> tenant route override for acme -> model small-medium fallback. their 5xx rate dropped to ~2% from 12% after switch.

sam-g: note: disabling prefix cache increases token cost slightly but helps reduce long KV stalls that were blocking queues. we'll re-enable after verifying behaviour and can apply a safer rollout for prefix caching.

alex-r: any queue reordering / starvation observed post-change?

maria-p: not seeing priority inversion. priority lanes healthy. one oddity: a handful of long-running requests still held live on GPU leading to slow decrease. recommending an eviction policy tweak: reduce long_request_grace to 30s for public tenants to allow faster eviction.

sam-g: agree. I'll schedule quick kube rollout to push eviction config: long_request_grace_seconds=30 for sandbox/public.

ops-runner: patched config, rolling to runtime pool A/B.

maria-p: after eviction tweak, inflight reclaimed faster. overall P95 latency back to baseline within 8 minutes.

alex-r: can we confirm no config broke any dedicated customers?

sam-g: confirmed dedicated/gold tenants unchanged. changes targeted to role=sandbox and role=public.

jamie-c: CS updated acme with mitigation summary and planned follow-up. they asked for post-incident writeup + ETA on prefix-cache safety testing.

maria-p: next steps: 1) keep emergency caps for 30m then gradually relax 2) run controlled A/B for prefix cache on <10% traffic for 2 hours 3) postmortem to cover why KV cache miss spike happened (model size mismatch + sudden seq-length spike).

alex-r: logging action items. i'll open INC-2026-71685 and assign postmortem owners. maria, sam — can you capture timeline and commands used?

sam-g: on it, will paste snippets into the incident doc.

maria-p: i'll add metrics and Grafana snapshots, plus suggested long-term mitigation: adaptive per-tenant cache warming and backpressure earlier in the ingress gateway.

ops-runner: monitoring alert thresholds back to normal but leaving page hooks enabled.

jamie-c: scheduled customer follow-up call with acme for 10:30 PT.

alex-r: thanks all. if anything regresses, @maria-p will re-open. otherwise we ramp down emergency caps in 30m and monitor. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: [RESOLVED?] runtime-queue-depth back under threshold for 10m. auto-note: mitigation actions recorded.

maria-p: marking as resolved for now. postmortem owner assigned to sam-g. closing thread once postmortem is drafted.
